Steps 1–3 are the core: GRPO, how R1 used it, and Tülu 3's RLVR. 4–8 are the fixes and frontier recipes built on top. 9 asks what RLVR really teaches. 10 is the code to try it.

How to track your reading

1. Select a paper card
2. Pick a Background colour:
   yellow = reading
   green = done
3. Jot notes in each series' yellow notes sticky

Ctrl+click a paper's name to open it on arXiv. Ctrl+F finds any paper across all pages.

Dates are first arXiv submission (v1). Some arXiv IDs carry a later month than their date, for example DeepSeek-V4 (2606.19348, listed Apr 26, 2026); that is how arXiv lists them. "Co-authored" means DeepSeek researchers co-wrote the paper with a university lab. Llama 4 and SmolLM3 have no arXiv report, so they link to the official blog.
